hook: The largest active volcano on Earth woke up after 38 years.
narration: The largest active volcano on Earth was erupting for the first time since 1984.
Mauna Loa, on Hawaii's Big Island. It began at the summit, around eleven thirty at night.
Then it broke open along a line of fissures, throwing fountains of lava into the air.
Fountains like these come from gas in the magma expanding fast as it reaches the surface, like opening a shaken soda.
The lava ran down one side of the mountain.
outcome: After about twelve days, Mauna Loa stopped erupting.
title: Mauna Loa erupts after 38 years
description:
Mauna Loa on Hawaii's Big Island, the world's largest active volcano, began erupting in late November 2022 for the first time since 1984. The eruption lasted about 12 days.
